verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out control, such as a setting, environment variable or flag, for the SDK or the Wally CLI. The docs cover on-device inference keeping prompts local and offline use without an account, but these concern where inference runs, not disabling telemetry. A single community reply says "no data is collected", but it is unverified and is not documented product capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
